metadata.title: About | Swagger Editor App
metadata.description: Learn about the RS School React course, Swagger Editor App, and its development team.

hero.title: Swagger Editor App
hero.description: A team-built workspace for editing, exploring, and testing OpenAPI specifications from one responsive interface.

course.title: Built at The Rolling Scopes School
course.description: RS School is a free, community-based online education program. Its React course combines modern frontend theory with practical teamwork and culminates in the collaborative Swagger/OpenAPI UI project.

community.title: Community driven
community.description: Students learn with peers, mentors, and contributors from the international Rolling Scopes community.

practice.title: Built through practice
practice.description: The curriculum covers TypeScript, testing, state management, forms, performance, and Next.js through hands-on assignments.

open.title: Open learning
open.description: Course materials, documentation, and community resources are available online for independent study.

project.title: One workspace for OpenAPI
project.description: Swagger Editor App brings schema editing, endpoint documentation, request execution, and authenticated request history into one full-stack React application.

team.title: Created together
team.description: Three frontend developers collaborate across architecture, interface design, testing, and delivery.

resources.title: Project resources
resources.description: Continue with the official course, school documentation, or the project source code.
